verdict.rationale: Daryanani Law Group is a boutique, attorney-led immigration law firm offering visa and green-card legal services, not a software product with user data, so in-product AI-generated insights are a category error for this kind of offering. Nothing in the evidence shows any software product, client portal, or AI feature that would make the axis apply.
